state.description: Where the page stands on its way to the signed-in application. loading: no web document yet. sign-in-required: the sign-in monitor of the browser finds a sign-in or verification wall; the person signs in: read the page (DSphere shows them the sign-in), then dsagent.page.wait until authentication-cleared. signed-in: the monitor checked the application page and found no wall. unchecked: the application page is open and the monitor could not check it yet; read the page.
